name: kcmps-cashbook-lambdas
description: Dependencies for backend/cashbook/*.js (Cash Book + job costing, Phase 1 — see docs/cashbook-job-costing-plan-2026-08-18.md). Deploy each handler .js file as its own Lambda; shared.js is bundled alongside it in every zip, and both it and the handler need the `require("../lib")` -> `require("./lib")` rewrite plus a flattened copy of backend/lib/. DynamoDB only — no S3, no SES: this feature sends no email and touches no bucket.
